## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her dishonest nature, with a reputation for being a cheat. She also displays a envious side, frequently making disparaging remarks about Julia due to her jealousy.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## History

Gertie Pye was among the schoolmates who warmly welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back when she decided to return to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Later, Gertie attended a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where the group learned that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) intended to rent his fences out for advertising.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--jane-andrews.md)

Gertie Pye and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) are acquaintances and fellow canvassers within the community. They both participate as members of the local Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), +2 more_
